notes.title: Spring Quest Sale: Dobuki's Epic Journey!
notes.content:
🌌 [b]Blast Off with Dobuki This Spring![/b] 🌌  
The Steam Spring Sale is in full orbit, and *Dobuki's Epic Journey* is landing with a galaxy-sized discount! This quirky mashup of point-and-click adventure and RPG sends you on a wild ride with Dobuki, a lovable hero, and Yookim, a sassy singer with attitude. Together, you’ll explore three vibrant planets, outsmart Emperor Lik Wang, and save the galaxy—one laugh at a time. With its cartoony Flash vector art and dark, whimsical humor, this is an adventure that defies the rulebook.

[h2]What’s in Store Across the Stars:[/h2]
- [b]Three Wild Planets: [/b]From countryside quirks to cosmic caves, every location’s a puzzle-packed surprise.  
- [b]Non-Linear Chaos: [/b]Solve riddles, level up skills, and stumble into unexpected encounters.  
- [b]A Dev’s Dream:[/b] Born from a spontaneous spark—think *Monkey Island* meets *Phantasy Star* with a dash of madness.  
- [b]Closure Conquered:[/b] Years of random ideas (space travel! 3D caves! a love interest!) tied up with a quirky bow.  

This isn’t just a game—it’s a passion project that grew from a “what if?” into a sprawling, silly saga. The Spring Sale’s your chance to snag it cheap and dive into Dobuki’s world of weird creatures, spontaneous twists, and galactic giggles. No planning, just pure adventure—share your cosmic conquests with #DobukiSpring and let’s save the galaxy together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197246/a2816b2f7dece603cb71ff83195a10f413a0601a.jpg[/img]

🌟 [b]Launch Before the Sale Warps Away:[/b] Grab it now and see where Dobuki’s journey takes you!
